profile.comment_range: Create 3 is a small indoor robot (radius ~0.17 m). nearRangeM is dropped to 0.05 m so close obstacles are not in a blind zone, and farRangeM (20 m) sits above the SLAM max_laser_range (15 m) and costmap raytrace_max_range (12 m) so those YAML values remain the effective limit.

emitterStates.comment_elevation: 0.0 keeps the single beam horizontal; the Example_Rotary_2D preset used -2.0 deg, which tilts the planar scan into the floor (phantom ring at ~3.4 m for a 0.12 m mount height).
